metadata.name: Cell — chemotaxis OPEN-LOOP control (nav_gain 0)
metadata.description: Phase 6.7 — open-loop counterfactual control for the_cell_chemotaxis_ai.json. Identical two-module chain (ScentCompass → ChemotaxisAI) with ChemotaxisAI nav_gain=0: the percept.scent_compass bearing is still computed and delivered, but action is SEVERED from it (the cell drives straight forward, never steering on the gradient). Pairs with the closed-loop config to show the hit rate comes from the perception→action loop closure, not bare forward motion — the Cell analog of the picrawler A2 active-inference signature. Script-only control; NOT in the launcher allowlist.
